purpose: Run an explicit local plan, generation, and validation sequence in one foreground invocation while preserving the curated public plugin marketplace and refusing hidden background work or external delivery actions.

executionModel.name: supervised-foreground-plan-and-build
executionModel.rule: The runner exists only while its foreground command is running. It cannot continue work after the command exits.

commandAllowlist.purpose: check SEIS Core application catalog freshness

plan.purpose: Inspect current local state and report the next safe foreground phases.

applySafe.purpose: Run only the reviewed local generation and validation allowlist during the current foreground invocation.

githubDelivery.nextAction: After a focused commit and current authorization, use a separate feature-branch delivery action. Do not push from the autopilot.

validatorBoundary.reason: The official validator and its Python dependencies are environment-owned, so the portable runner does not hard-code a machine-specific path or install dependencies.

rollback.scope: Revert the focused autopilot generator, runner, documentation, and package scripts. The curated marketplace and retained source packages are unaffected by plan mode.
